data.short_meaning: Honour; prestige; reputation; dignity; good name
data.long_meaning: Aabroo (آبرو) is a Persian name meaning “Honour; prestige; reputation; dignity; good name”. It is a Persian compound of āb (آب) 'water' and rū (رو) 'face', literally 'the water of the face', a classical Persian idiom for the flush of dignity or shame. In Persian and Urdu ābrū means repute, standing and honourable character.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabroo carries the meaning Honour; prestige; dignity. Any spiritual reading placed on the name is interpretive and is labelled as such; the lexical meaning is the documented core.
data.etymology: Persian compound āb (آب) 'water' + rū (رو) 'face', literally 'water of the face', an idiom for dignity and repute.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabroo total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: How is Aabroo written in Persian and Urdu?
faq.a: Aabroo is written آبرو in both Persian and Urdu, and आबरू in Devanagari.

faq.a: Aabroo is a Persian compound of āb (آب) water and rū (رو) face, literally water of the face, an idiom for dignity and repute.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabroo?
faq.a: The root of Aabroo is Persian ābrū (آبرو), from āb (آب) water plus rū (رو) face.

faq.q: Does Aabroo appear in the Qur'an?
